### Not a Hoof
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/greg-laurie-devotion-august-21-2021.html
Passage: Exodus 10:26
Points:
- Believers cannot draw others to Christ by lowering standards or conforming to the world.
- Pharaoh sought a compromise by demanding Israel leave their livestock behind as leverage.
- Moses refused to negotiate, insisting that not even a single hoof would be left behind.
- Christians must reject any compromise with the devil rather than attempting to live in two worlds.
- Spiritual freedom requires making a clean break from sin through a close walk with Jesus.

### A Prayer for the Obstacles in Your Way
Author: Chelsey DeMatteis
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-prayer/a-prayer-for-the-obstacles-in-your-way.html
Passage: Exodus 10:21
Points:
- People tend to measure their lives by obstacles rather than by God's steadfast faithfulness.
- During the plague of darkness over Egypt, God provided light in the dwellings of His people.
- Darkness surrounded the Israelites, yet God ensured it did not consume them.
- Like the Israelites, believers often forget past deliverances and slip into anxiety or complaining.
- Daily faith requires shifting focus away from roadblocks and fixing attention on God's sustaining presence.
